name: Student Visa (9(f))

requirements.blocker_text: Requires admission to a school, university, or training programme recognised by the Commission on Higher Education or the Department of Education.
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission from a recognised Philippine institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires proof of sufficient funds for tuition and living costs, plus medical and police clearances.
requirements.fix_path: Provide bank statements, a scholarship award letter, and required clearances.

outcome.duration_length: tied to programme length, renewed annually

sources.title: Live Life the Philippines -- Philippine Visas (2026): Your Options, describing the 9(f) student visa category and its work restriction
